caseStudies.title: From Stagnant Sales to 73% Growth – Kitchen Brand Transformation
caseStudies.excerpt: Strategic overhaul of listings, creatives, and PPC cut ACOS and boosted conversions across Home and Kitchen ASINs.
caseStudies.heroSubheadline: From stagnant sales to sustained growth through catalog optimization and targeted PPC restructuring.

challenge.heading: The challenge
paragraphs: The brand had been selling on Amazon for 14 months but faced stagnation. Product reviews averaged 4.4 stars, conversion rates had plateaued below 11%, and PPC campaigns were inefficient with average ACOS around 51%.
Visuals were generic, listings were keyword-stuffed, and the brand had no cohesive identity on Amazon.

keyIssues: Underwhelming click-through rate (0.7%) on key listings
Poor indexing for mid- and long-tail keywords
Inconsistent A+ content across parent listings
Lack of post-purchase funnel or review collection strategy

steps.title: Listing overhaul and SEO layering
steps.description: Keyword gap analysis and semantic mapping balanced TOFU and BOFU terms; titles and bullets emphasized clear USPs.

steps.title: Visual identity and A+ redesign
steps.description: Hero imagery, comparison modules, and a cohesive brand story improved CTR and A+ engagement.

steps.title: Ad account restructure
steps.description: SKAG structure with discovery, ranking, and retention phases plus time-of-day bid modifiers.

steps.title: Review funnel and brand store
steps.description: Compliant review requests, inserts, and storefront cross-sell pages increased reviews and multi-ASIN sales.

strategyStages.title: Listing overhaul and SEO layering
bullets: Keyword gap analysis with Helium 10 and Brand Analytics
Semantic keyword mapping across TOFU and BOFU terms
Titles and bullets rewritten around clear USPs
strategyStages.outcome: Indexed for 142 new keywords; 38 ranking on page 1 after 30 days.

strategyStages.title: Visual identity and A+ content redesign
bullets: Hero images with size indicators and mobile contrast
Lifestyle A+ modules and competitor comparison charts
Why Choose Us story using voice-of-customer language
strategyStages.outcome: CTR improved from 0.7% to 1.6%; A+ scroll depth up 48%.

strategyStages.title: Ad account restructure (PPC 2.0)
bullets: SKAGs for granular control
Discovery, ranking, and retention campaign phases
Peak-hour bid modifiers (Mon–Fri, 6–9 PM EST)

strategyStages.title: Post-purchase review funnel and inserts
bullets: Request a Review API flow across three touchpoints
Branded insert with compliant bonus content offer
VOC phrases fed back into listings and FAQs
strategyStages.outcome: Review rate 2.1% to 3.6%; 212 verified reviews in 45 days.

strategyStages.title: Brand store and cross-sell strategy
bullets: Store rebuilt around bestsellers and bundles
Collection sub-pages for baking and eco-friendly kitchen
Sponsored Brand Video to curated storefront sections
strategyStages.outcome: Brand Store CVR 4.8% to 9.2%; 14.7% of sales from cross-ASIN navigation.

caseStudies.title: PPC Recovery – Cutting Wasted Ad Spend and Driving Profitable Traffic
caseStudies.excerpt: Clean PPC structure cut waste and improved profitability across Amazon US and UK for an electronics accessories brand.
caseStudies.featuredImageAlt: VoltTech Accessories PPC recovery case study
caseStudies.heroSubheadline: A 60-day PPC rehab rebuilt campaigns with a profit-first structure after overlapping keywords left ACOS at 76%.

challenge.heading: The challenge
paragraphs: VoltTech was bleeding ad spend after outsourcing PPC to a low-cost agency. Campaigns were disorganized with poor targeting and extreme keyword overlap. ACOS averaged 76% and TACoS climbed above 42% despite stagnant organic sales.

keyIssues: Over 300 keywords across 17 overlapping campaigns
46% of spend on search terms with zero conversions
No negative keywords or proper bid segmentation
Sponsored Display campaigns cannibalizing branded sales

steps.title: Full ad audit and spend forensics
steps.description: Mapped campaigns by SKU and intent; isolated converting terms from a 180-day search term report.

steps.title: Campaign restructure
steps.description: Built a three-campaign core per SKU plus defensive branded campaigns.

steps.title: Bid adjustments and reporting
steps.description: Dayparting, weekend bid cuts, dynamic bidding down-only, and a custom performance dashboard.

strategyStages.title: Full ad audit and spend forensics
bullets: Mapped all campaigns by SKU and keyword intent
Identified redundant terms consuming 24% of spend
180-day search term report for converting terms

strategyStages.title: Campaign restructure
bullets: Exact Match Ranking, Phrase Discovery, and Auto per SKU
Defensive branded campaigns against competitor conquest

strategyStages.title: Bid adjustments and time segmentation
bullets: Peak-hour bid boosts (6–10 PM local)
Weekend bid reductions from historical ROAS
Dynamic bidding – down only

strategyStages.title: PPC reporting system
bullets: Weekly ACOS by campaign type
Organic vs PPC sales split
Search term performance trends
